description: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) catalogue search, version 2026-08-25 (dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search). arguments: meta {'ucp-agent': {profile}} (required) and catalog {query, context {address_country}, filters {categories, price {min, max} in minor units}, pagination {limit, cursor}}. Serves the priced subset: rows whose maker's list price is on the record (claimed seats with a listed price), keyed by GTIN, each with its claim_status. Every other row stays on search_cleared_items.
name: search_catalog
title: Search Catalog
